ontology.note: Emits fw:RasterPointSample with the sampled attribute, the cell size, the stated sampling convention, the unit status and four counts. The term is declared for this release; a shape over it is not yet written.

changes.description: Reads each value as the cell containing the point, or between the four nearest cells (bilinear), chosen and stated in its receipt. A missing value among the four gives none; a point without four cells around it is outside. On the standard Inspector and dialog (experiments 186, 198).

evidence.note: Seven unit checks cover the containing-cell value, no-data and masked cells, points outside the grid, points without coordinates, the half-open cell edges, a refused existing attribute, refused attribute names and a refused CRS. A cell value is not a measurement at the point and no interpolation is claimed. Agreement with an external point sampler is not established; see docs/experiments/67-sample-raster-at-points.md. Composition is established by tests/composition-elevation.test.mjs, a minimal fixture wiring Area around a point to Clip raster to Sample raster at points with synthetic data. The sea-level worked example remains the teaching artifact and does not gate this release; see the protective/maturity distinction in docs/audits/ontology-audit.md. 0.2.0: tests/raster-point-registration.test.mjs checks bilinear against hand arithmetic, a missing neighbour and an edge point.
